blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Allen Laurenaria hit the go-ahead basket in overtime to lift Jose Rizal University past Perpetual Help, 72-70, in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena on Tuesday night. His clutch heroics punctuated an impressive performance of 20 points, six rebounds, and four steals as the Heavy Bombers improved to a Group A best 7-2 record.
